summary: Collections use shared resources differently from standalone modules: doc fragments work within and across collections, optional module utils support multiple ansible-core versions, and collections can depend on others.
questions: How are doc fragments and module_utils handled differently in collections?
Can a collection depend on another collection?

answer_card.title: Shared resources in collections
answer_card.answer_md: In collections, documentation fragments can be used within and across collections, optional module utilities help support multiple ansible-core versions, and collections can depend on other collections.
